<!-- dropi-planning-id: PROG-001 -->
## Program Overview

**Program ID:** PROG-001  
**Canonical Scope:** DROPi Mobile roadmap materialization for GitHub planning  
**Primary Milestone Anchor:** M1 — Application Core Foundation

### Mission
Materialize the complete canonical roadmap into a GitHub-native planning structure that preserves history, exposes execution order, and keeps the remaining work visible without recreating already closed canonical recovery issues.

### Hierarchy
- 6 active phase issues (M1–M6)
- 30 epic issues aligned to the layered roadmap and transversal modules
- 60 batch issues used for sequencing and grouping implementation work
- 120 executable implementation issues with stable IDs
- 5 owner-decision issues, 3 canonical-resolution issues, and 3 verification/documentation issues

### Canonical Sources and Preservation Rules
- BLUEPRINT/DROPi_ROADMAP_BY_LAYERS.md is the primary execution map for layers, phases, and step groupings.
- AUDIT_TRACKING.md supplies the 10 pending audit items that remain open after the 252/262 completion snapshot.
- canonical/AI_DEVELOPMENT_HANDOVER_CANON.md defines the continuity, safety, and non-restart rules.
- canonical/SESSION_HANDOVER.md confirms current implementation context and must remain historically intact.
- Closed issues #42–#50 (CAN-001 through CAN-008) are preserved as historical recovery evidence and are intentionally not re-created in this materialization set.

### Current Status
- Canonical recovery is complete (M0 closed).
- Application Core and Audit Core contain partially implemented capability that still needs GitHub issue normalization.
- The most immediate open backlog items are operational-role approval, unverified delivery partner gating, real-time updates, push notifications, offline sync, mock-data replacement, biometric planning, language selector, and QA-debugger verification.

### Definition of Done
- Every issue in this materialization set maps to an existing canonical source, implementation observation, or audit gap.
- Milestones, labels, and issue references are internally consistent and stable.
- Historical certification artifacts remain preserved and future work stays traceable back to the active canon.

- Record the chosen architectural stance and propagate it to M1/M6 planning artifacts.

### Definition of Done

- Superseded interpretations are explicitly marked historical.
